description: Source code for a Frappe/ERPNext module handling student report generation, including report preview, attendance calculation, and assessment report processing.

classes.name: StudentReportGenerationTool
classes.description: A Document subclass representing the student report generation tool.

methods.name: preview_report_card
methods.description: Generates a preview of the student's report card, including assessment results, attendance, and formatting the report as a PDF.

methods.name: get_courses_criteria
methods.description: Retrieves assessment criteria for each course.

methods.name: get_attendance_count
methods.description: Calculates attendance counts for a student within a specified academic year or term.
